in_sanskrit.name: Mapleeta
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mapt: Amrit (nectar of immortality), Leeta: Lotus
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mapleeta एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Mapleeta is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘mapt’ which means ‘Amrit’, the divine nectar of immortality, and ‘leeta’ meaning ‘lotus’. This name symbolizes the divine grace and spiritual enlightenment associated with the lotus flower.
